title: M$^\text{4}$World: A Multi-view Multimodal Driving World Model for Interactive Object Manipulation and Minute-long Streaming
summary: Driving-world generation has emerged as a core capability for scalable autonomous-driving simulation, yet existing methods remain limited in object-level controllability and long-horizon stability. We present M$^\text{4}$World, a Multi-view and Multimodal generative driving world model that synthesizes future surround-view video streams and synchronized LiDAR scans while supporting interactive object Manipulation and stable Minute-long streaming. Fine-grained object manipulation is realized through a flexible conditioning interface that supports explicit control over both the spatial layout and visual appearance of individual objects. Stable minute-long streaming, on the other hand, is achieved through a multi-stage training framework that enables online causal generation in only four denoising steps while maintaining coherent world dynamics throughout extended rollouts. Building on these components, we introduce an efficient few-clip post-training as well as a suite of visual reference-conditioned generation models, preserving general generation ability while allowing rare-case customization for long-tail controllability. To assess controllability beyond realism, we further introduce an automated VLM-based judging pipeline that evaluates scene-level condition adherence, view-wise object controllability, and cross-view object consistency. Comprehensive experiments show that M$^\text{4}$World consistently delivers high generation quality, precise controllability, and stable minute-long streaming. Together with downstream long-tail augmentation and scene editing, these results demonstrate the potential of M$^\text{4}$World for controllable, scalable driving simulation.
tldr: M4World is a multi-view multimodal driving world model that generates surround-view video and LiDAR scans with interactive object manipulation and stable minute-long streaming for scalable autonomous driving simulation.
tldr_zh: M4World 是一个多视角多模态驾驶世界模型，能够生成环视视频和激光雷达扫描，支持交互式物体操作和稳定的分钟级流式生成，用于可扩展的自动驾驶仿真。
summary_zh: 驾驶世界生成已成为可扩展自动驾驶仿真的核心能力，但现有方法在对象级可控性和长时域稳定性方面仍存在局限。我们提出M⁴World——一种多视角多模态生成式驾驶世界模型，能够合成未来环视视频流与同步激光雷达扫描数据，同时支持交互式对象操控与稳定的分钟级长时流生成。精细化的对象操控通过灵活的条件控制接口实现，该接口可显式控制单个对象的空间布局与视觉外观。稳定的分钟级长时流则通过多阶段训练框架达成，仅需四次去噪步骤即可实现在线因果生成，并在扩展生成过程中保持连贯的世界动态。基于上述组件，我们引入高效少样本后训练技术及一套视觉参考条件生成模型，在保留通用生成能力的同时，允许针对长尾可控性进行罕见场景定制。为超越真实感评估可控性，我们进一步提出基于视觉语言模型的自动化评估流程，用于评测场景级条件服从性、视角级对象可控性及跨视角对象一致性。全面实验表明，M⁴World持续展现出高生成质量、精确可控性与稳定的分钟级长时流生成能力。结合下游长尾增强与场景编辑应用，这些结果证明了M⁴World在可控、可扩展驾驶仿真领域的潜力。

title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment
summary: Finetuning a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) on robot demonstrations via behavior cloning (BC) has become the standard recipe for vision-language-action (VLA) policies. However, BC finetuning progressively overwrites the pretrained representations that support visual and semantic generalization. Co-training on web image-text data, a common remedy, does not prevent this; it applies language and action losses to separate observations, leaving VLAs with language-action misalignment that standard manipulation benchmarks do not expose. We propose Anchor-Align, which augments BC with two objectives: Vision-Language Anchoring distills layer-wise representations from a frozen VLM copy to prevent this drift, while Language-Action Alignment converts each action target into a discrete motion-direction label and jointly trains language and action prediction on the same robot observation. On a physical xArm7 robot, across two widely used VLA architectures, Anchor-Align improves real-robot success on both (28% to 54% and 37% to 60%). At scale in simulation, we demonstrate consistent improvements on OOD perturbations, perceptual robustness, and long-horizon control across LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN, respectively, suggesting that preserving pretrained representations and effective action learning are not fundamentally at odds. Project page: anchoralignvla.github.io
tldr: Anchor-Align improves VLA finetuning by adding vision-language anchoring to prevent representation drift and language-action alignment to co-train language and action predictions, boosting real-robot success rates significantly.
tldr_zh: Anchor-Align 通过添加视觉-语言锚定以防止表示漂移，以及语言-动作对齐以联合训练语言和动作预测，改进了VLA微调，显著提升了真实机器人的成功率。
summary_zh: 通过行为克隆（BC）在机器人演示数据上微调预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM），已成为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的标准方法。然而，BC微调会逐步覆盖支持视觉与语义泛化的预训练表征。常见的补救措施——在网络图像-文本数据上进行协同训练——并不能阻止这一现象；它将语言损失和动作损失应用于不同的观测数据，导致VLA存在语言-动作不匹配问题，而标准操作基准测试无法揭示这一问题。我们提出Anchor-Align方法，通过两个目标增强BC：视觉-语言锚定（Vision-Language Anchoring）从冻结的VLM副本中蒸馏逐层表征以防止表征漂移；语言-动作对齐（Language-Action Alignment）将每个动作目标转化为离散的运动方向标签，并在同一机器人观测数据上联合训练语言预测与动作预测。在物理xArm7机器人上，跨两种广泛使用的VLA架构，Anchor-Align将真实机器人成功率分别从28%提升至54%、从37%提升至60%。在仿真环境的大规模实验中，我们分别在LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN上展示了在分布外扰动、感知鲁棒性和长期控制任务中的一致改进，这表明保留预训练表征与有效的动作学习并非根本对立。项目页面：anchoralignvla.github.io

title: Instant NuRec: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Reconstruction for Driving Scene Simulation
summary: 3D simulation platforms are critical for autonomous driving because they enable end-to-end policy evaluation, thereby reducing development costs and improving safety. In recent years, neural simulation has become predominant, with methods such as NuRec playing a central role; however, these methods remain relatively slow and typically require per-scene tuning. In this work, we present Instant NuRec, a feed-forward neural reconstruction model that turns a short multi-view driving log into a fully simulatable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) world in a single forward pass. The model accepts multi-view input from a calibrated camera rig and emits a layered output consisting of static and dynamic 3DGS layers, a sky cubemap, and per-camera ISP corrections, while providing native support for non-pinhole camera models via 3DGUT. It reconstructs a 10-20-second multi-camera scene in roughly 1.5 seconds and achieves a PSNR on the Waymo Open Dataset that is 2.01 dB above the strongest evaluated baseline. Instant NuRec is deeply integrated into NuRec and is compatible with AlpaSim for closed-loop simulation.
tldr: Instant NuRec is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction model that converts short multi-view driving logs into simulatable 3DGS worlds in a single forward pass, enabling fast closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: Instant NuRec 是一个前馈式 3D 高斯重建模型，可将短时多视角驾驶日志通过单次前向传播转换为可模拟的 3DGS 世界，支持自动驾驶闭环仿真。
summary_zh: 三维仿真平台对自动驾驶至关重要，因其支持端到端策略评估，从而降低开发成本并提升安全性。近年来，神经仿真成为主流，NuRec等方法发挥着核心作用，但这些方法仍相对缓慢，且通常需要针对每个场景进行调参。本研究提出Instant NuRec——一种前馈式神经重建模型，可将短时多视角驾驶日志通过单次前向传播直接转化为具备完全仿真能力的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景。该模型接收来自标定相机阵列的多视角输入，输出由静态与动态3DGS层、天空立方体贴图及逐相机ISP校正参数构成的分层结果，并通过3DGUT原生支持非针孔相机模型。其能在约1.5秒内重建10-20秒的多相机场景，在Waymo开放数据集上比最强评估基线高出2.01 dB的PSNR。Instant NuRec深度集成于NuRec框架，并兼容AlpaSim以实现闭环仿真。

title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
summary: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagination play complementary roles. Language provides the abstract structure of a plan, including task decomposition, planning primitives, constraints, temporal order, and decision logic, while visual imagination grounds this structure through world state prediction and joint subgoal planning, associating each planning step with intermediate and final physical states. RxBrain adopts a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports language, image, and video understanding and generation within one model. To train this capability, we build an automatic pipeline that converts embodied videos into joint text-visual planning supervision by decomposing videos into planning steps and aligning them with visual state transitions. We further introduce RxBrain-Bench to evaluate whether models can represent embodied plans through joint textual and visual components rather than separate understanding or generation. Experiments show that RxBrain maintains embodied understanding and generation abilities, and produces plans with coupled textual reasoning, world state prediction, and joint subgoal planning. We also extend RxBrain to continuous robot action generation, where it shows promising real-robot performance without large-scale action-data pretraining. These results provide an initial step toward foundation models for embodied cognition.
tldr: This paper presents RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model that jointly performs language-visual reasoning and imagination, generating unified planning sequences with both textual and visual components. It demonstrates real-robot performance without large-scale action-data pretraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RxBrain，一个联合语言-视觉推理与想象的具身认知基础模型，能够生成包含文本和视觉组件的统一规划序列，并在无需大规模动作数据预训练的情况下展示了真实的机器人性能。
summary_zh: 具身认知要求智能体将高层任务推理与需达成的物理状态相连接。我们提出Hy-Embodied-RxBrain——一个具备联合语言-视觉推理与想象能力的具身认知基础模型。不同于强调场景理解与文本决策的视觉语言模型，或主要预测未来视觉状态的生成式世界模型，RxBrain以单一规划序列表征具身规划，其中语言与视觉想象扮演互补角色：语言提供规划的抽象结构，包括任务分解、规划基元、约束条件、时间顺序与决策逻辑；视觉想象则通过世界状态预测与联合子目标规划，将各规划步骤与中间及最终物理状态相关联，从而具体化该结构。RxBrain采用统一的跨模态Transformer混合架构，支持在同一模型内进行语言、图像与视频的理解与生成。为训练该能力，我们构建了自动流水线：通过将具身视频分解为规划步骤并与视觉状态转换对齐，将视频转化为联合文本-视觉规划监督信号。我们进一步引入RxBrain-Bench评估基准，用以检验模型能否通过文本与视觉联合组件表征具身规划，而非仅执行孤立的理解或生成任务。实验表明，RxBrain保持了具身理解与生成能力，能生成耦合文本推理、世界状态预测与联合子目标规划的规划方案。我们还将RxBrain拓展至连续机器人动作生成领域，在无需大规模动作数据预训练的情况下，展现出颇具前景的真实机器人性能。这些结果为基础模型走向具身认知迈出了初步一步。

title: Semantic Audio-driven Understanding for Dynamic Humanoid Whole Body Control
summary: Recent advances in humanoid robotics and reinforcement learning have enabled the acquisition of highly expressive whole-body motion policies. However, most robotic performances remain based on pre-scripted sequences or externally triggered behaviors, limiting autonomy and responsiveness to dynamic environments. In this work, we introduce a novel multi-modal orchestration framework for semantic audio-driven humanoid control, enabling robots to autonomously select and execute appropriate motion skills in real time. The system processes continuous audio streams and routes them into music or speech branches. Music input is handled via audio fingerprinting and semantic embeddings to retrieve track identity and temporal alignment, allowing dynamic mapping between musical segments and motion policies. Speech input is grounded into a discrete library of imitation-learned skills, enabling direct human-robot interaction. Both modalities share a unified interface that schedules skill execution over a reinforcement learning control pipeline. We validate the approach in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid, showing robust sim-to-real transfer and consistent audio-conditioned policy selection. Supplementary materials are available at the following site: https://lab-rococo-sapienza.github.io/semantic-WBC/
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-modal framework that enables a humanoid robot to dynamically select and execute whole-body motion skills driven by semantic audio (music or speech) using audio fingerprinting, semantic embeddings, and reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多模态协调框架，使类人机器人能够根据语义音频（音乐或语音）动态选择并执行全身运动技能，结合了音频指纹、语义嵌入和强化学习。
summary_zh: 近年来，人形机器人与强化学习的进展使得获取高表现力的全身运动策略成为可能。然而，大多数机器人表演仍基于预设序列或外部触发行为，限制了其对动态环境的自主性与响应能力。本研究提出了一种新颖的多模态编排框架，用于语义音频驱动的人形机器人控制，使机器人能够实时自主选择并执行适当的运动技能。该系统处理连续音频流，并将其分流至音乐或语音分支。音乐输入通过音频指纹与语义嵌入进行解析，以获取曲目身份与时间对齐信息，从而实现音乐片段与运动策略之间的动态映射。语音输入则被映射至一个由模仿学习技能构成的离散库中，从而支持直接的人机交互。两种模态共享统一接口，该接口通过强化学习控制管道调度技能执行。我们在仿真环境及Unitree G1人形机器人上验证了该方法，展现了稳健的仿真到现实迁移能力与一致的音频条件策略选择效果。补充材料可通过以下网站获取：https://lab-rococo-sapienza.github.io/semantic-WBC/

title: UESF-Bench: Benchmarking and Probing for Unified Embodied Seeking and Following
summary: Language-guided human following is an important capability for embodied agents, but existing benchmarks typically assume that the target person is visible at the start of an episode. This setting simplifies the problem and overlooks a more realistic requirement: an agent often needs to first find a language-described target and then persistently follow that target in a dynamic environment. While recent work has started to study human search, existing settings are typically evaluated in task-specific scenarios and often rely on stronger prior knowledge of the environment. Moreover, they usually treat searching and following as separate tasks and still lack a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce the Unified Embodied Seeking and Following Benchmark (UESF-Bench), a large-scale and diverse benchmark for embodied human seeking and following. The benchmark requires agents to handle semantic-guided exploration, reliable behavior switching and recovery, and delayed identity grounding. To this end, we propose SeekFollow-VLA, a vision-language-action framework with a task-driven routing mechanism for latent phase inference and transition modeling between seeking and following. Experimental results show that SeekFollow-VLA achieves clear improvements over both single-head and dual-head baselines across single-person and multi-person environments, establishing a baseline for unified embodied seek-and-follow.
tldr: UESF-Bench introduces a benchmark and a VLA framework (SeekFollow-VLA) for unified embodied human seeking and following, where the agent must first find a language-described target and then follow it persistently in dynamic multi-person environments.
tldr_zh: UESF-Bench提出了一个统一的具身搜索与跟随基准及VLA框架（SeekFollow-VLA），要求智能体首先找到语言描述的目标，然后在动态多人物环境中持续跟随该目标。
summary_zh: 语言引导的人体跟随是具身智能体的重要能力，但现有基准通常假设目标人物在回合开始时可见。这一设定简化了问题，忽略了更现实的需求：智能体往往需要先找到语言描述的目标，然后在动态环境中持续跟随该目标。尽管已有研究开始探索人体搜索，但现有设定通常在特定任务场景下评估，且往往依赖更强的环境先验知识。此外，它们通常将搜索与跟随视为独立任务，仍缺乏用于系统性评估的统一基准。为解决这些局限，我们提出了统一具身搜索与跟随基准（UESF-Bench），这是一个面向具身人体搜索与跟随的大规模多样化基准。该基准要求智能体处理语义引导的探索、可靠的行为切换与恢复，以及延迟的身份确认。为此，我们提出了SeekFollow-VLA——一个带有任务驱动路由机制的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于隐式阶段推理以及搜索与跟随之间的状态转换建模。实验结果表明，在单人和多人环境中，SeekFollow-VLA相较于单头与双头基线均取得了显著提升，为统一具身搜索与跟随任务建立了基准。

title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich semantic representations from pretrained Vision-Language Models, yet fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations degrades this structure and undermines generalization. A fundamental question therefore arises: what constitutes a good action representation? Inspired by the mirror neuron theory's insight that observation and execution share an intention-level encoding, we examine whether a robot's action representations preserve the semantic structure captured by pretrained encoders. Systematic probing confirms that this structure erodes during finetuning, and that its quality synchronizes with both task success and out-of-distribution generalization. We further introduce a plug-and-play method that anchors action representations to a semantic manifold while decomposing representations into a shared semantic channel and a private channel, all discarded at inference, leaving the deployed model unchanged. Validated on different VLA backbones across simulation and real-world benchmarks, our method yields up to +18.7% on real-world in-distribution tasks and +21.5% on out-of-distribution generalization.
tldr: This paper investigates the degradation of semantic structure in VLA models during fine-tuning and proposes a plug-and-play method that anchors action representations to a semantic manifold, improving generalization and task success on real-world robots.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了VLA模型在微调过程中语义结构的退化现象，并提出了一种即插即用的方法，将动作表示锚定到语义流形上，从而提升了真实世界机器人的泛化能力和任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型继承了预训练视觉-语言模型的丰富语义表征，然而在有限的机器人演示数据上进行微调会破坏这一结构并削弱泛化能力。因此，一个根本性问题随之产生：何为良好的动作表征？受镜像神经元理论中关于观察与执行共享意图层面编码的启发，我们探究了机器人动作表征是否能够保留预训练编码器所捕获的语义结构。系统性探测证实，该结构在微调过程中逐渐退化，且其质量与任务成功率及分布外泛化能力同步变化。我们进一步提出一种即插即用方法，将动作表征锚定在语义流形上，同时将表征分解为共享语义通道与私有通道——两者在推理阶段均被舍弃，最终部署模型保持不变。在仿真与真实世界基准测试中，基于不同VLA骨干网络的验证表明，该方法在真实世界分布内任务上带来高达+18.7%的性能提升，在分布外泛化任务上带来+21.5%的提升。

title: Agile perceptive multi-skill locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild
summary: Enabling quadrupedal robots to traverse complex terrains-from rugged outdoor environments to urban landscapes-requires seamless integration of multiple motor skills, smooth transitions between gaits, and high-speed perceptive locomotion using only onboard sensors. We present APT-RL (Action Pretrained Transformer-based Reinforcement Learning), a unified framework that enables multi-skill locomotion to achieve high-speed traversal in complex environments through autonomous skill transitions utilizing only onboard perception and computation. Our approach generates large-scale, feature-rich 2D motion datasets through trajectory optimization with simplified dynamics. These datasets enable training of diverse, reusable locomotion skills that transfer effectively to a real quadruped robot operating on complex uneven terrains. The resulting high-quality skills serve as strong priors for efficient learning of complex downstream tasks and extend naturally to 3D environments, enabling smooth, high-speed multi-skill locomotion in deployed policy. Real-world experiments demonstrate the framework's capabilities: the robot performs agile maneuvers through complex indoor obstacles and outdoor wild environments, including dynamic drop-down maneuvers that reach instantaneous peak speeds of up to 6 meters per second. A single onboard policy enables robust traversal of diverse obstacles, including stairs, hurdles, stepping stones, gaps, and fallen branches, demonstrating the versatility and effectiveness of our approach.
tldr: APT-RL unifies trajectory optimization and reinforcement learning to train a single multi-skill locomotion policy for quadruped robots, enabling agile, high-speed traversal of complex real-world terrains using only onboard sensing and computation.
tldr_zh: APT-RL 结合轨迹优化和强化学习，为四足机器人训练统一的多样技能运动策略，仅靠机载感知与计算即可在复杂真实地形上实现敏捷高速穿越。
summary_zh: 使四足机器人能够穿越复杂地形——从崎岖的户外环境到城市景观——需要无缝整合多种运动技能、实现步态间的平滑切换，并仅依赖机载传感器完成高速感知运动。我们提出了APT-RL（基于预训练动作变换器的强化学习），这是一个统一框架，通过仅利用机载感知与计算实现自主技能切换，从而在复杂环境中完成高速穿越的多技能运动。该方法通过简化动力学的轨迹优化，生成大规模、特征丰富的二维运动数据集。这些数据集可用于训练多样化、可复用的运动技能，并有效迁移至运行于复杂非平整地形的真实四足机器人。所获高质量技能作为高效学习复杂下游任务的强先验，且能自然扩展至三维环境，使部署策略实现平滑、高速的多技能运动。真实世界实验验证了该框架的能力：机器人可在复杂室内障碍与户外野外环境中完成敏捷机动，包括瞬时峰值速度达6米/秒的动态下落动作。单一机载策略即可稳健穿越多种障碍——包括楼梯、跨栏、垫脚石、间隙与倒伏树枝——充分展示了本方法的通用性与有效性。

title: Learning Physics-Guided Residual Dynamics for Deformable Object Simulation
summary: Simulating deformable objects is essential for a wide range of robotic manipulation applications, yet accurately predicting their dynamics remains challenging. We propose Physics-Guided Residual Dynamics (PGRD), a hybrid simulation framework that combines the advantages of physics-based and learning-based approaches. Specifically, PGRD combines an optimizable spring-mass simulator as a backbone with a learned neural network that predicts residual corrections to the physics-based predictions. We adopt a velocity-based formulation to ensure stable simulation and a sliding-window transformer architecture to capture temporal dependencies. We show that PGRD produces more accurate results than both purely physics-based and learning-based methods on a set of diverse real-world deformable objects. We further demonstrate the utility of PGRD in two applications: manipulation planning via Model Predictive Control, including a language-conditioned setting with a generated goal image; and interactive simulation via action-conditioned video prediction by 3D Gaussian Splatting.
tldr: Proposes a hybrid physics+learned residual dynamics framework for deformable object simulation, validated on real-world data and used in MPC-based manipulation planning and interactive simulation.
tldr_zh: 提出一种物理与学习残差混合的变形体动力学仿真框架，在真实数据上验证，并用于MPC操纵规划与交互仿真。
summary_zh: 模拟可变形物体对多种机器人操作应用至关重要，但准确预测其动力学特性仍具挑战性。我们提出物理引导残差动力学（PGRD），一种结合物理驱动与学习驱动方法优势的混合仿真框架。具体而言，PGRD将可优化的弹簧-质量模拟器作为主干，并与预测物理模型残差修正项的学习型神经网络相结合。我们采用基于速度的公式确保仿真稳定性，并运用滑动窗口变换器架构捕捉时间依赖性。实验表明，在多种真实可变形物体上，PGRD相较于纯物理方法及纯学习方法均能产生更精确的结果。我们进一步展示了PGRD在两类应用中的实用性：通过模型预测控制实现操作规划（包括基于语言条件生成目标图像的场景），以及通过三维高斯溅射实现基于动作条件视频预测的交互式仿真。

title: Adapting Generalist Vehicle Models for High-Speed MPC Across Terrains
summary: High-speed off-road autonomy requires precise closed-loop control for a target vehicle while remaining robust across changing terrains. Recent forward kinodynamic (FKD) prediction foundation models suggest a promising path, starting from a generalist model and specializing it to the target platform. However, effective specialization remains challenging, as it often requires substantial real-world data, and models adapted to one setting can still overfit to specific terrains or driving regimes. We present OptCar (Optimized Car), a recipe for bridging the gap from generalist to specialist FKD models that preserves cross-terrain generalization while optimizing performance for a specific vehicle. $\texttt{OptCar}$ introduces a history-conditioned dynamics adaptation module that encodes recent state-action observations into a dynamics context token, and then fine-tunes the generalist model using limited real-world data together with targeted synthetic rollouts from environment-specific system identification. In closed-loop model predictive control (MPC) experiments across three terrains and an out-of-distribution cart-pulling task, the largest gains appear at 6~m/s, the highest speed evaluated and the regime in which slip dominates tracking error. On vegetation and dirt, the most slip-diverse terrain, OptCar reduces 6~m/s trajectory tracking error by roughly 55% relative to a fine-tuned AnyCar baseline, and remains the most accurate even when an unseen cart payload changes the dynamics. With only 5 minutes of real data per terrain, OptCar is competitive on road with a specialist trained on 30 minutes of road data, and substantially outperforms it once the terrain changes.
tldr: OptCar introduces a history-conditioned dynamics adaptation module to fine-tune a generalist forward kinodynamic prediction model for high-speed off-road MPC, achieving superior trajectory tracking with minimal real-world data and robust cross-terrain generalization.
tldr_zh: OptCar提出了一种历史条件动力学自适应模块，用于微调通用前运动学预测模型以用于高速越野MPC，在极少真实数据下实现优越的轨迹跟踪和跨地形泛化。
summary_zh: 高速越野自主驾驶要求对目标车辆实现精确的闭环控制，同时在不同地形中保持鲁棒性。近期提出的前向运动动力学（FKD）预测基础模型展示了一条有前景的路径：从通用模型出发，再针对目标平台进行特化。然而，有效的特化仍然具有挑战性，因为它通常需要大量真实世界数据，且适应于某一场景的模型仍可能对特定地形或驾驶模式过拟合。我们提出OptCar（优化车辆），这是一种弥合通用型与特化型FKD模型之间差距的方案，在针对特定车辆优化性能的同时，保持跨地形的泛化能力。$\texttt{OptCar}$引入了一个历史条件动态适应模块，该模块将最近的状态-动作观测编码为动态上下文标记，然后利用有限的真实世界数据以及环境特定系统辨识生成的目标合成轨迹数据，对通用模型进行微调。在横跨三种地形及一项分布外拖车任务中的闭环模型预测控制（MPC）实验中，最大提升出现在6米/秒——即所评估的最高速度下，该速度区间内滑移主导了跟踪误差。在植被和泥土这一滑移多样性最高的地形上，OptCar相比微调后的AnyCar基线将6米/秒轨迹跟踪误差降低了约55%；即便在未见过的拖车负载改变动力学特性时，其精度仍然最高。每种地形仅需5分钟真实数据，OptCar在公路上便与基于30分钟公路数据训练的特化模型性能相当，且一旦地形改变，其性能显著超越后者。

title: Open-AoE: An Open Egocentric Manipulation Dataset and Toolchain for Embodied Learning
summary: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide scalable supervision for embodied intelligence, yet existing resources rarely combine low-cost continuous capture, manipulation-level structured annotations, and reusable tools for robot learning. We present Open-AoE, an open, community-oriented egocentric manipulation dataset and toolchain spanning the full pipeline from smartphone capture to model training. Its first release contains approximately 2,000 hours of manipulation video collected in natural environments by 500+ contributors using 400+ smartphones. The dataset provides text annotations, MANO-based hand poses, camera trajectories, and temporally localized atomic actions. Open-AoE further includes a data processing pipeline that transforms raw recordings into structured samples through temporal action segmentation, semantic annotation, hand reconstruction, and camera trajectory reconstruction. Meanwhile, we provide a separate downstream toolchain supports visualization, cross-embodiment retargeting, model-specific data conversion, and training recipes for VLA policies, WAMs, and World Models. By integrating scalable capture, structured processing, and downstream adaptation, Open-AoE reduces the barriers to both data contribution and reuse, providing practical open infrastructure for embodied model training, human-to-robot transfer, and world modeling.
tldr: Open-AoE provides a large-scale egocentric manipulation dataset and an end-to-end toolchain for embodied learning, supporting VLA policies, world models, and human-to-robot transfer.
tldr_zh: Open-AoE 提供了一个大规模的第一人称操作数据集和完整的工具链，支持 VLA 策略、世界模型以及人机迁移学习。
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人体操作视频为具身智能提供了可扩展的监督信号，然而现有资源很少能同时兼顾低成本连续采集、操作级结构化标注以及可复用的机器人学习工具。我们提出Open-AoE——一个面向社区的开放式以自我为中心操作数据集与工具链，涵盖从智能手机采集到模型训练的完整流程。其首个版本包含由500余名贡献者使用400余部智能手机在自然环境中采集的约2000小时操作视频。数据集提供文本标注、基于MANO的手部姿态、相机轨迹及时间定位的原子动作。Open-AoE进一步包含数据处理流水线，通过时间动作分割、语义标注、手部重建和相机轨迹重建将原始记录转化为结构化样本。与此同时，我们提供独立的上下游工具链，支持可视化、跨本体重定向、模型特定数据转换，以及用于VLA策略、WAMs和世界模型的训练方案。通过整合可扩展采集、结构化处理与下游适配，Open-AoE降低了数据贡献与复用的门槛，为具身模型训练、人机迁移和世界建模提供了实用的开放基础设施。

title: Exploratory, Communicative, and Deployable: Vision-Driven Embodied Agents for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
summary:
Real-world deployment of embodied agents requires active exploration, visual grounding, and interactive intent disambiguation. However, existing frameworks often rely on privileged simulator states or assume complete instructions, bypassing realistic deployment challenges. To bridge this gap, we present REAL, an agentic framework for open-world mobile manipulation. REAL establishes sim-to-real-consistent environment APIs without oracle perception and integrates a simulated user to enable human-in-the-loop interaction. Within this environment, we design diverse task compositions to drive data collection, supervised fine-tuning, and online reinforcement learning, systematically optimizing agent performance. To comprehensively evaluate this approach, we introduce REAL-Bench, a benchmark spanning 241 tasks across active exploration, visual distraction, articulated manipulation, and interactive disambiguation.
  Experimental results demonstrate that our trained agent outperforms leading commercial closed-source VLMs on interactive tasks with a 56.9% success rate. Further empirical analysis reveals that our hierarchical training pipeline successfully aligns the model's tool-use capabilities while maintaining robust open-vocabulary reasoning under extended exploration horizons. Finally, we deploy and evaluate our framework on a physical dual-arm mobile robot, where it achieves a 78.3% end-to-end success rate over 60 real-world episodes. These physical trials demonstrate robust zero-shot transferability to unseen household scenarios, validating that our sim-to-real-consistent design successfully bridges the reality gap for long-horizon mobile manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL.
tldr: REAL presents a framework for open-world mobile manipulation that integrates sim-to-real APIs, a simulated user, hierarchical training, and a benchmark (REAL-Bench), achieving strong zero-shot transfer on a physical dual-arm robot.
tldr_zh: REAL提出了一个面向开放世界移动操作的智能体框架，集成了仿真到真实环境的API、模拟用户、分层训练和基准测试（REAL-Bench），在实物双臂机器人上取得了显著的零样本迁移效果。
summary_zh: 具身智能体在现实世界中的部署需要主动探索、视觉定位以及交互式意图消歧。然而，现有框架往往依赖特权化的模拟器状态或假定指令完整，规避了实际部署中的挑战。为弥合这一差距，我们提出REAL——一个面向开放世界移动操控的智能体框架。REAL无需使用神谕感知即可建立模拟-现实一致的环境应用编程接口，并集成模拟用户实现人在回路的交互。在该环境中，我们设计了多样化的任务组合以驱动数据收集、有监督微调与在线强化学习，系统性地优化智能体性能。为全面评估该方法，我们引入REAL-Bench基准测试集，涵盖241项任务，涉及主动探索、视觉干扰、铰接式物体操控及交互式消歧。实验结果表明，我们训练的智能体在交互式任务中以56.9%的成功率超越领先的商业闭源视觉语言模型。进一步的实证分析揭示，我们的分层训练流水线在保持稳健的开放词汇推理能力的同时，成功对齐了模型的工具使用能力，并且能够适应扩展的探索视野。最终，我们在实体双臂移动机器人上部署并评估该框架，在60个真实世界测试场景中实现了78.3%的端到端成功率。这些物理实验证明了其对未见家庭场景的稳健零样本迁移能力，验证了我们的模拟-现实一致设计成功弥合了长时域移动操控的现实鸿沟。代码已开源：https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL。

title: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1: Towards a Multimodal Embedding Model for Robots
summary: A robot must understand the state of its own body, but a camera sees only part of it. Force and contact leave almost no trace in a single frame, and raw vision features read force at $R^2$ at or below $0.10$ on every robot we test. We present Kepler-Encoder-v0.1, a robot-first multimodal encoder that treats robot state as a modality and fuses vision, proprioception, and force/torque into a single shared latent with a learned-query cross-attention layer, trained self-supervised by masked cross-modal prediction under the LeJEPA/SIGReg objective. At evaluation only vision enters, which poses a sharp question. Does fusing state into training make the vision-only latent carry anything the pixels do not already contain? On the RH20T corpus the answer is yes, precisely where the camera is weakest. On held-out scenes, the vision-only latent recovers end-effector state, and force in particular, significantly above both raw frozen-ViT features and a compute-matched vision-only control on every sensored robot, though absolute force recovery at a single timestep is modest; on motor state, which the camera largely sees, it is statistically tied with the strongest vision baselines, and it is the only feature whose latent geometry tracks state. A single embodiment-agnostic encoder covers four robots, and a data-matched control shows this breadth reflects embodiment diversity rather than data volume. The frozen latent is directly useful. Its own cross-modal prediction error is a training-free invalid-state monitor (AUROC $0.90$ on out-of-range states, $0.69$ on scene-swapped states), and a diffusion decoder (PixNerd) reconstructs the camera frame from the latent, confirming the spatial compression preserves world-state. This report validates the single-timestep case; native-rate temporal fusion is the next step.
tldr: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1 is a robot-first multimodal encoder that fuses vision, proprioception, and force/torque via self-supervised cross-modal prediction, enabling a vision-only latent to recover force and state information missing from raw pixels across multiple robot embodiments.
tldr_zh: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1 是一个以机器人为中心的多模态编码器，通过自监督跨模态预测融合视觉、本体感和力/扭矩，使得仅视觉的潜在表示能够恢复原始像素缺失的力和状态信息，并适用于多种机器人实体。
summary_zh: 机器人必须理解自身本体状态，但相机只能观测到其中一部分。力和接触信息在单帧图像中几乎不留下痕迹，而在我们测试的每一款机器人上，原始视觉特征对力的解读能力均处于$R^2 \leq 0.10$的水平。我们提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，这是一种以机器人为中心的多模态编码器，将机器人状态视为一种模态，通过可学习的查询交叉注意力层，将视觉、本体感知与力/力矩融合至单一共享潜在空间，并采用LeJEPA/SIGReg目标下的掩码跨模态预测进行自监督训练。在评估阶段仅输入视觉信息，这引发了一个尖锐的问题：将状态融合至训练过程，是否能让仅依赖视觉的潜在表征承载像素本身所不具备的信息？在RH20T数据集上的答案是肯定的，且恰好体现在相机最薄弱的环节。在留出场景中，该视觉仅潜在表征能够恢复末端执行器状态（尤其是力信息），其性能在所有配备传感器的机器人上均显著高于原始冻结ViT特征以及计算量匹配的纯视觉对照模型——尽管在单时间步长上的绝对力恢复能力有限；而对于相机基本可观测的电机状态，该表征与最强的视觉基线在统计上持平，且它是唯一潜在几何结构能跟踪状态的表征。一个与具体本体无关的编码器即可覆盖四种机器人，而数据量匹配的对照实验表明，这种宽泛的覆盖能力源于本体多样性而非数据规模。冻结后的潜在表征具有直接实用性：其自身的跨模态预测误差可作为无需训练的无效状态监测器（对超出范围状态的AUROC为0.90，对场景互换状态为0.69），而扩散解码器（PixNerd）能从该潜在表征重建相机帧，证实空间压缩保留了世界状态。本报告验证了单时间步长情况；原生速率的时间融合是下一步工作。

title: From Language to Navigation Goals: A Vision-Language Approach for Semantic Navigation of Mobile Robots Using RGB-D Perception
summary:
Natural language interaction provides an intuitive way for non-expert users to communicate with robotic platforms. However, transforming user requests into executable navigation actions remains a challenging task, requiring the integration of language understanding, environment perception, and autonomous navigation. This work presents a language-driven navigation framework that enables mobile robots to interpret user requests in natural language to move the robot to a destination and autonomously navigate towards it.
  The framework is composed of modular ROS 2 components that cooperate to transform natural language instructions into navigation actions. Given a natural language request referring to a target in the environment (e.g., "go to the mail box"), the system identifies the referenced object, estimates its position using RGB-D data, and generates a navigation goal, which is then executed through the ROS 2 Nav2 navigation stack. The ROS 2-based implementation facilitates portability across different robotic platforms, requiring only the configuration of the corresponding topics and services.
  The system is evaluated in both simulation and real-world scenarios using a TurtleBot3 Waffle and a Unitree Go2 robot with a RealSense camera. Experimental results show that the framework successfully interprets both direct commands and contextual requests, generates meaningful natural-language feedback, and navigates towards the desired target. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining semantic perception and autonomous navigation to provide an intuitive human-robot interaction paradigm. Code will be released as open source upon acceptance.
tldr: This paper presents a modular ROS 2 framework that uses a vision-language approach to interpret natural language commands and generate navigation goals for mobile robots, validated on TurtleBot3 and Unitree Go2 platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化的ROS 2框架，利用视觉-语言方法解释自然语言指令并生成移动机器人导航目标，在TurtleBot3和Unitree Go2平台上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 自然语言交互为非专业用户与机器人平台沟通提供了直观方式。然而，将用户请求转化为可执行的导航动作仍是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要整合语言理解、环境感知与自主导航。本研究提出一种语言驱动的导航框架，使移动机器人能够解析用户以自然语言发出的请求，从而将机器人移动至目的地并自主导航抵达该位置。该框架由模块化ROS 2组件构成，协同将自然语言指令转化为导航动作。当接收到指向环境中目标的自然语言请求（例如"去邮箱那里"）时，系统会识别所引用的目标物体，利用RGB-D数据估算其位置，生成导航目标，并通过ROS 2 Nav2导航堆栈执行该目标。基于ROS 2的实现便于跨机器人平台移植，仅需配置对应的主题和服务。我们在TurtleBot3 Waffle与搭载RealSense摄像头的Unitree Go2机器人上，通过仿真与真实场景对系统进行了评估。实验结果表明，该框架能成功解析直接指令与上下文请求，生成有意义的自然语言反馈，并导航至预期目标。这些结果证明了融合语义感知与自主导航以实现直观人机交互范式的可行性。代码将在论文被接收后以开源形式发布。

title: The SIGReg Objective as Variational Free Energy: A Theoretical Active-Inference Account of JEPA World Models
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are the dominant design for latent world models, yet they are usually justified by empirical performance rather than a normative principle. We show that the choice of anti-collapse regulariser determines whether a JEPA's training objective, a prediction loss plus a weighted embedding regulariser, is a valid Active Inference (AIF) variational free energy. We organise four non-contrastive regularisers (VICReg, LogDet, PairDist, and SIGReg) into an entropy-estimator hierarchy indexed by a prior-miscalibration gap, and show that the gap's sign, whether the estimator bounds the latent entropy from above or below, decides whether the AIF surprise bound survives: VICReg and LogDet are unsafe upper bounds, PairDist a safe lower bound, and SIGReg eliminates the gap. We then prove a correspondence theorem: under the standard constant-noise encoder model and successful SIGReg enforcement (isotropic-Gaussian embeddings), the gap vanishes, the objective becomes an exact information bottleneck, the surprise bound is preserved, and the latent goal cost becomes an exact proxy for AIF pragmatic value, whereas VICReg leaves an irreducible second-order anisotropy term. We extend the correspondence to multi-step expected free energy, ensemble epistemic value, and a learned-policy regime, and we identify the one AIF term no current JEPA world model computes: the state-epistemic value, a future-state coverage signal. The predictions differ in kind, not degree, and are stated here as theoretical consequences left for empirical test in separate work; full proofs are in Appendix A, and the algebraic core of every result is machine-verified in Lean 4 (Appendix D).
tldr: This paper provides a theoretical Active Inference grounding for Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), showing that the choice of anti-collapse regularizer determines whether the JEPA objective equates to variational free energy, and identifies SIGReg as a safe regularizer that bridges world models and Active Inference.
tldr_zh: 本文为联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）提供了基于主动推理的理论基础，表明抗崩溃正则化器的选择决定了JEPA目标是否等同于变分自由能，并指出SIGReg是一种安全的正则化器，能够连接世界模型与主动推理。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）是隐世界模型的主流设计，但其合理性通常依赖于经验性能而非规范性原理。我们证明，反坍塌正则化器的选择决定了JEPA训练目标（预测损失加加权嵌入正则化项）是否为有效的主动推理（AIF）变分自由能。我们将四种非对比正则化器（VICReg、LogDet、PairDist和SIGReg）组织成一个以先验失配缺口为索引的熵估计器层级，并指出该缺口的符号（即估计器从上方还是下方约束隐空间熵）决定了AIF惊奇界是否成立：VICReg和LogDet是不安全的上界，PairDist是安全的下界，而SIGReg消除了该缺口。随后我们证明了一个对应定理：在标准恒定噪声编码器模型和成功施加SIGReg（各向同性高斯嵌入）的条件下，缺口消失，目标函数成为精确的信息瓶颈，惊奇界得以保持，隐空间目标成本成为AIF实用价值的精确代理，而VICReg则留下不可约的二阶各向异性项。我们将该对应关系推广至多步期望自由能、集成认知价值以及学习策略机制，并识别出当前JEPA隐世界模型未计算的唯一AIF项：状态认知价值——一种未来状态覆盖信号。这些预测存在本质差异而非程度差异，本文将其作为理论推论呈现，留待后续工作通过实证检验；完整证明见附录A，所有结果的代数核心已通过Lean 4完成机器验证（附录D）。

title: Cyclone: Diffusion Model for Cycle-Consistent Weather Editing from Unpaired Driving Data
summary: Reliable perception under diverse weather conditions remains a major challenge for autonomous driving systems. A common strategy to improve robustness is either to synthesize adverse weather conditions for training perception models or to apply weather-removal techniques to recover clean inputs. However, existing approaches typically rely on synthetic data augmentation or physics-based, task-specific models that require paired training data and often struggle to generate realistic weather effects or generalize robustly to out-of-domain scenarios. Toward this problem, we present Cyclone, a unified framework for weather editing based on latent diffusion, equipped with cycle-consistent constraints and knowledge from image-text models. Cyclone enables the generation of multiple weather conditions across diverse scenes while eliminating the need for paired data. Experimental results show that our approach produces more realistic, structure-preserving outputs than existing baselines and leads to consistent improvements across several downstream driving perception tasks. Furthermore, we demonstrate that Cyclone can be distilled to a video diffusion model for temporally consistent weather editing.
tldr: Cyclone is a latent diffusion framework for cycle-consistent weather editing from unpaired driving data, improving perception robustness.
tldr_zh: Cyclone 是一个基于潜在扩散的循环一致性天气编辑框架，无需配对数据，可提升自动驾驶感知鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 在复杂天气条件下实现可靠感知，仍是自动驾驶系统面临的主要挑战。提升鲁棒性的常见策略，要么是合成恶劣天气条件用于训练感知模型，要么应用天气移除技术恢复清晰输入。然而，现有方法通常依赖合成数据增强或基于物理的、任务专用的模型，这些模型需要成对训练数据，且往往难以生成逼真的天气效果，或无法稳健地泛化到域外场景。针对这一问题，我们提出了Cyclone——一个基于潜在扩散、配备循环一致性约束与图文模型知识的统一天气编辑框架。Cyclone能够在跨场景条件下生成多种天气效果，同时消除对成对数据的依赖。实验结果表明，与现有基线方法相比，我们的方法能生成更逼真、保持结构完整的输出，并在多个下游驾驶感知任务中带来持续改进。此外，我们证明Cyclone可通过知识蒸馏应用于视频扩散模型，实现时间一致的天气编辑。

title: Towards a Modular Bin-picking Framework for Handling Object Pose Uncertainties
summary:
In recent years, there has been growing interest in robust robotic systems for precise bin-picking applications. To achieve reliable performance, such systems must address errors arising from both the object pose estimation and the grasping process. Although various approaches have been proposed, they typically target specific challenges and do not offer general solutions. In this paper, we present a modular framework that jointly handles both error types. The framework incorporates object pose distribution estimation to account for pose uncertainty, which frequently arises in situations with ambiguous observations where a single correct pose cannot be determined. To further reduce uncertainty, we introduce a second-viewpoint module that computes complementary pose distributions, which are subsequently fused. This fusion decreases overall uncertainty and improves system efficiency. Additionally, two independent modules are included to compensate for grasping errors. The modular design allows the components to be combined for optimal performance or used individually, depending on the physical setup.
  The proposed method is evaluated in a real-world setup with three different objects, with no errors, and all modules are shown to improve efficiency. These results suggest that incorporating pose distributions with grasping pose errors is a promising direction for developing more flexible and reliable robotic production systems.
  To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework that jointly addresses both grasping and object pose uncertainties using interchangeable modules. We believe there is ample opportunity to integrate additional modules, resulting in improved performance and flexibility. The current framework is limited to pose uncertainties in SO(2), but it could be extended to SE(3), enabling additional modules to improve the system.
tldr: A modular bin-picking framework that jointly handles object pose uncertainties and grasping errors using pose distribution estimation, second-viewpoint fusion, and interchangeable modules, evaluated on real robots.
tldr_zh: 一个模块化的料箱抓取框架，通过姿态分布估计、第二视角融合和可互换模块，联合处理物体位姿不确定性和抓取误差，在真实机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh:
近年来，针对精密抓取应用的鲁棒机器人系统引起了广泛关注。为实现可靠性能，此类系统必须处理由物体姿态估计和抓取过程产生的误差。尽管已有多种方法被提出，但它们通常针对特定挑战，无法提供通用解决方案。本文提出了一种模块化框架，可联合处理这两类误差。该框架通过引入物体姿态分布估计来应对姿态不确定性——这种不确定性常出现于观测模糊、无法确定单一正确姿态的场景。为进一步降低不确定性，我们引入了第二视角模块来计算互补姿态分布，随后进行融合。该融合过程降低了整体不确定性，提升了系统效率。此外，框架包含两个独立模块用于补偿抓取误差。模块化设计允许各组件根据实际物理配置进行组合以优化性能，或独立使用。

本方法在包含三个不同物体的真实场景中进行了评估，且误差为零，所有模块均被证明能提升效率。这些结果表明，将姿态分布与抓取姿态误差相结合，是开发更灵活、更可靠的机器人生产系统的有前途方向。

据我们所知，这是首个通过可互换模块联合处理抓取与物体姿态不确定性的框架。我们坚信有充分机会集成更多模块，从而提升性能与灵活性。当前框架仅局限于SO(2)空间中的姿态不确定性，但未来可扩展至SE(3)空间，使附加模块能够进一步改进系统。

title: EgoHTR: Egocentric 4D Demonstrations of Human Terrain Traversal
summary: Deploying humanoid robots in unstructured terrain remains an open problem. While classic reinforcement learning struggles with the sheer complexity of real-world interactions, more promising methods leveraging human priors remain limited to models lacking contextual awareness. The restricted motion synthesis is a direct consequence of existing dataset pipelines failing to capture human-scene sequences in challenging environments. To bridge this gap between humanoid learning and scene reconstruction, we introduce the Egocentric Human-Terrain Reconstruction (EgoHTR) dataset. We develop and open-source a reconstruction pipeline capturing 55 scene-aligned 4D human motion sequences in diverse, complex environments using a multi-sensor setup of egocentric wearables and a portable 3D scanner. The resulting dataset comprises over 150k frames, which we evaluate against motion-capture ground truth, demonstrating state-of-the-art accuracy and establishing a rigorous benchmark for human motion analysis and synthesis. Further, we leverage this data to train perceptive locomotion policies, demonstrating hardware deployment on a Unitree G1 for reconstructed reference motions. Our pipeline enables community-driven dataset extensions and factors the problem to help researchers build foundational, context-aware robots that reliably traverse uneven terrain.
tldr: This paper presents the EgoHTR dataset and pipeline for capturing egocentric, scene-aligned 4D human motion in complex terrain, and uses this data to train perceptive locomotion policies deployed on a real humanoid robot (Unitree G1).
tldr_zh: 本文提出了EgoHTR数据集和重建流程，用于在复杂地形中捕捉以自我为中心的场景对齐的4D人体运动，并利用该数据训练感知运动策略，在真实人形机器人（Unitree G1）上部署。
summary_zh: 在非结构化地形中部署人形机器人仍是一个未解决的难题。经典强化学习方法难以应对真实世界交互的极端复杂性，而更具前景的利用人类先验知识的方法则受限于缺乏环境感知能力的模型。现有数据采集流程无法在复杂环境中获取包含人类-场景交互序列，这直接制约了运动合成的表现。为弥合人形机器人学习与场景重建之间的鸿沟，我们提出了"第一人称视角人类-地形重建数据集"(EgoHTR)。我们开发并开源了一套重建流程，通过头戴式多传感器设备与便携式3D扫描仪的联合配置，在多样化复杂环境中采集了55组场景对齐的4D人体运动序列。该数据集包含超过15万帧图像，经动作捕捉真值验证，展现出业界领先的精度水平，为人体运动分析与合成建立了严格基准。我们进一步利用该数据训练感知运动策略，成功在宇树G1机器人上实现了重建参考运动的硬件部署。我们的技术方案支持社区驱动的数据集扩展，通过问题分解方法帮助研究者构建具备环境感知能力、能稳定穿越复杂地形的基础模型机器人。

title: Just-In-Time Scene Graph Growth: Combating Perceptual Saturation in Long-Horizon Robotics
summary: While 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) provide crucial structured representations for embodied agents, conventional Ahead-of-Time, build-everything-then-filter pipelines conflict with the real-time, low-latency demands of edge platforms, inducing a perceptual saturation effect via severe observation redundancy. To resolve this, we present JITOMA (Just-In-Time On-demand Memory Activation), a closed-loop framework that unifies task reasoning, perception, and memory into a just-in-time growth process. Instead of exhaustively mapping the entire environment, JITOMA leverages a top-down task heatmap at the frontend to filter continuous observations, routing minimal streams to maintain a global foundation of low-cost, dormant anchors. Upon a cognitive query, the backend Large Language Model (LLM) parses the robotic intent to dynamically awaken task-relevant anchors, triggering resource-intensive operations -- such as dense node captioning and functional inference -- exclusively within the activated local subgraph. To evaluate these dynamic capabilities and study perceptual saturation trade-offs, we introduce JITOMA-Bench, a comprehensive suite for long-horizon multi-tasking and complex multi-step reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that JITOMA substantially reduces active graph size and captioning latency, while maintaining stable processing time under long-horizon task switching.
tldr: JITOMA proposes a closed-loop, just-in-time 3D scene graph growth framework that uses an LLM to dynamically activate task-relevant anchors, reducing perceptual saturation and latency in long-horizon robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: JITOMA 提出了一种闭环、即时的 3D 场景图增长框架，利用 LLM 动态激活与任务相关的锚点，减少长时间机器人任务中的感知饱和和延迟。
summary_zh: 尽管三维场景图（3DSG）为具身智能体提供了关键的结构化表示，但传统的“预先构建、先建全再过滤”管道与边缘平台对实时性和低延迟的需求存在冲突——严重的观测冗余会引发感知饱和效应。为解决此问题，我们提出JITOMA（即时按需记忆激活），这是一种将任务推理、感知与记忆统一为即时增长过程的闭环框架。JITOMA并非对整个环境进行穷举式映射，而是利用前端自顶向下的任务热图过滤连续观测数据，仅路由最小化数据流以维护低成本、休眠状态的全局锚点。当接收到认知查询时，后端大语言模型（LLM）解析机器人意图以动态唤醒任务相关锚点，仅在激活的局部子图中触发密集节点标注与功能推理等资源密集型操作。为评估这些动态能力并研究感知饱和的权衡特性，我们提出JITOMA-Bench——面向长周期多任务处理与复杂多步推理的综合基准套件。大量实验表明，JITOMA在显著降低活跃图规模与标注延迟的同时，能在长周期任务切换中保持稳定的处理时间。

title: When a Verified World Model Still Loses: Play-Adequacy vs Prediction-Accuracy in LLM-Synthesized Code World Models
summary:
Large language models can synthesize a game's rules as executable code - a Code World Model (CWM) - which a classical planner then searches over. Such models are typically accepted when they reach high transition accuracy on sampled trajectories. We argue this is the wrong notion of adequacy for planning.
  We show four things. (1) An LLM-synthesized CWM can pass a sampling gate at 100% transition accuracy and be $\geq 98\%$ state-accurate on the planner's own search distribution, yet lose systematically at play, because the $<1\%$ it gets wrong is exactly the pivotal dynamics; the play cost of the omitted rule is $0.091$ (seed-clustered 95% CI $[0.065,0.117]$, $n=4800$). We call this the verified-vs-correct gap, and confirm it end-to-end through the synthesis pipeline. (2) The harm follows a quantitative law, $\mathrm{danger}=\mathrm{play\_cost}\times(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$, whose $(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$ gate-miss factor is proven exact and whose play cost is empirically bounded. (3) The failure is not repaired by more data: LLM synthesis behaves as rule translation, not rule inference, and did not infer the omitted rule across models (GPT-5.x) and data regimes (including DAgger and targeted examples). (4) The same mechanism recurs on the belief-inference function of imperfect-information CWMs: we prove a coverage bound (a size-$N$ gate is identifying when $N\gtrsim b^{d_{\max}}$), explaining why shallow games such as Kuhn poker show no gap, and hand-construct Beacon, a verified-but-wrong inference function that passes the gate yet loses every game.
  These results suggest adequacy for planning-oriented world models should be measured on the search distribution or by play directly, not by prediction accuracy on sampled transitions.
tldr: This paper demonstrates that LLM-synthesized Code World Models can achieve near-perfect transition accuracy yet fail in planning due to missing rare but critical dynamics, advocating for evaluation on the search distribution or by direct play.
tldr_zh: 本文证明，LLM合成的代码世界模型即使达到近乎完美的转移准确率，也可能因遗漏罕见但关键的动态而在规划中失败，主张应在搜索分布或直接通过游戏来评估模型。
summary_zh:
大型语言模型能够将游戏规则综合为可执行代码——即代码世界模型（Code World Model, CWM）——随后由经典规划器对其进行搜索。此类模型通常在样本轨迹上达到较高的状态转移准确率时即被接受。我们认为，对于规划任务而言，这一充分性衡量标准并不正确。

我们展示了四点内容。（1）一个由LLM综合生成的CWM能够在采样门控中以100%的状态转移准确率通过，并在规划器自身的搜索分布上达到$\geq 98\%$的状态准确率，但在实际游戏中却系统性落败，因为其出错的$<1\%$恰好是关键性的动力学规则；被遗漏规则的游戏代价为$0.091$（基于种子聚类后的95%置信区间为$[0.065,0.117]$，$n=4800$）。我们将此称为“验证正确与实际正确之间的差距”，并通过合成流水线端到端地证实了这一点。（2）该危害遵循定量规律：$\mathrm{danger}=\mathrm{play\_cost}\times(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$，其中$(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$为门控遗漏因子，其推导精确成立，而游戏代价有经验上限。（3）增加数据无法修复该失效：LLM的合成行为类似于规则翻译，而非规则推理，并且未能跨模型（GPT-5.x）与数据模式（包括DAgger与针对性示例）推断出被遗漏的规则。（4）同一机制在不完美信息CWM的信念推理函数中也重复出现：我们证明了一个覆盖边界（当$N\gtrsim b^{d_{\max}}$时，大小为$N$的门控具有识别能力），解释了为何像Kuhn扑克这样的浅层游戏不出现差距，并手工构造了Beacon——一个通过门控验证但在每一场游戏中落败的“验证正确但实际错误”的推理函数。

这些结果表明，规划导向世界模型的充分性应在搜索分布上衡量或直接通过游戏表现评估，而非依据采样轨迹的预测准确率。

title: Grounded world models in biological organisms and future embodied AI
summary: Recent advances in generative and embodied AI have been driven by large-scale predictive learning over multimodal data. However, the resulting systems remain largely based on passive training regimes where linguistic regularities create the scaffold onto which information from other modalities is attached. Conversely, neuroscience and cognitive science suggest that biological intelligence is organized in the opposite way, where grounded world models acquired through interaction with the environment provide the semantic scaffold to which language is attached. Here, we illustrate five examples of neural circuits supporting grounded world modelling, which underlie navigation in physical and conceptual spaces, affordance-based perception and interaction with objects, active perception and exploratory learning, allostatic control and emotion, and the distinction between self- and world-generated outcomes. These examples highlight several features largely missing from current embodied AI, including the role of intrinsic dynamics as a foundation for learning, the centrality of action in aligning these dynamics with the external world, the prominence of autonomous experience and open-ended learning over passive assimilation of externally provided data, and the fact that early predictive and control mechanisms scaffold higher cognitive abilities such as reasoning, conceptual navigation, planning, imagination, understanding others' minds, and communication. Finally, we discuss whether and how principles derived from biological systems may inform future embodied AI, including training regimes based on social interaction to construct world models that are not only grounded but also socially shared and aligned with human norms and values.
tldr: This paper draws parallels between grounded world models in biological organisms and future embodied AI, advocating for interaction-driven, action-centric learning over passive data assimilation.
tldr_zh: 本文借鉴生物体内具身世界模型的实例，主张以交互驱动、行动为中心的学习模式推动未来具身AI发展。
summary_zh:
摘要：
生成式与具身人工智能的最新进展，得益于对多模态数据的大规模预测学习。然而，由此产生的系统仍主要基于被动训练模式，即语言规律为其他模态信息的附着构建起支撑框架。相反，神经科学与认知科学表明，生物智能的组织方式与此相反：通过与环境互动获得的具身世界模型，构成了语言所依附的语义框架。本文阐述了支撑具身世界建模的五类神经回路示例，这些回路是物理与概念空间导航、基于可供性的物体感知与交互、主动感知与探索性学习、稳态控制与情绪调节，以及区分自我与世界生成结果的基础。这些示例凸显了当前具身人工智能系统普遍缺失的若干特征，包括：内在动力学作为学习基础的作用、行动在将内在动力学与外部世界对齐中的核心地位、自主体验与开放式学习相对于被动吸收外部提供数据的优先性，以及早期预测与控制机制如何支撑推理、概念导航、规划、想象、心智解读与交流等高级认知能力。最后，我们探讨了源于生物系统的原理是否以及如何赋能未来的具身人工智能，包括基于社会互动的训练模式，以构建不仅具身化，而且具有社会共享性、符合人类规范与价值观的世界模型。

title: Learning Safe Agent Behaviour from Human Preferences and Justifications via World Models
summary: We address the problem of safely training an agent policy and deploying a good and safe policy, in settings where the environment dynamics are unknown and no suitable reward function is available. In the context of safety-critical environments, we consider traditional reinforcement learning impractical and resort to the resource of human input. We introduce DROPJ, a human-centred method for both safe training and deployment. We first learn a world model (a learned simulator) from a dataset of prior real-world trajectories. A human then plays the game in this learned simulator to extract several informative simulated trajectories. From these, we sample pairs of simulated trajectory segments and elicit from a human their preference over these segments, as well as a reason (justification) for their choice. We then train a reward model from these justified preferences and use it, together with the world model, to directly deploy the agent using model predictive control. Running real-user experiments, we find that generating informative simulated trajectories from a user significantly reduces the computational cost during training compared to other strategies, and can also improve the performance during deployment. In the context of training within a learned simulator, we show that the use of preferences rather than other types of feedback substantially improves the performance during deployment. We further demonstrate that safety justifications accompanying preferences can significantly enhance safety or prioritise user-prescribed aspects of safety associated with them during deployment.
tldr: This paper introduces DROPJ, a method that trains a reward model from human preferences and justifications using a learned world model, then deploys the agent via model predictive control to achieve safe behavior in safety-critical environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DROPJ方法，通过从人类偏好和理由中训练奖励模型，并利用世界模型进行模型预测控制部署，从而在安全关键环境中实现安全的智能体行为。
summary_zh: 我们探讨了在环境动态未知且无合适奖励函数的情况下，如何安全训练智能体策略并部署良好且安全的策略这一问题。在安全关键环境中，我们认为传统强化学习不切实际，转而借助人类输入资源。我们提出DROPJ，一种以人为中心的训练与部署安全方法。首先从先前的真实世界轨迹数据集中学习世界模型（即学习型模拟器）。随后，人类在该学习型模拟器中参与任务，提取若干具有信息量的模拟轨迹。从中成对采样模拟轨迹片段，并获取人类对这些片段的偏好及其选择理由（解释说明）。接着，我们根据这些附带理由的偏好训练奖励模型，并将其与世界模型结合，利用模型预测控制直接部署智能体。通过真实用户实验发现，与其他策略相比，从用户处生成信息丰富的模拟轨迹可显著降低训练阶段的计算成本，并能提升部署阶段的性能。在学习型模拟器的训练场景中，我们证明相较于其他反馈类型，使用偏好可大幅提升部署性能。进一步研究表明，伴随偏好提供的安全理由能在部署过程中显著增强安全性，或优先保障用户指定的安全相关方面。

title: Towards Spatial Supersensing in the Wild
summary: Humans can efficiently parse continuous sensory streams, from hours to years, scaffolding an internal world model that grounds spatial reasoning and prediction. To mimic this capacity, spatial supersensing challenges multimodal models to move beyond linguistic understanding toward true world modeling. However, their benchmark relies on synthetic long videos, formed by concatenating random short clips, and is mostly limited to household scenes, leaving real-world continuity and diversity underexplored. To address the gap, we introduce $\textbf{VSI-Super-Wild}$, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating spatial supersensing over long temporal horizons in diverse in-the-wild scenes. Notably, inspired by cognitive studies on how humans structure experience, we systematically probe the full triad of world state: the agent (observer), objects (scene items), and the environment (places and global layout). In total, VSI-Super-Wild contains $\textbf{6,980}$ human-verified question-answer pairs derived from $\textbf{442}$ real-world videos spanning 8 scene categories, including long-form recordings exceeding 4 hours. Results on VSI-Super-Wild expose a fundamental disconnect: despite advances in static image understanding, models consistently fail at tasks that require coherent world-state tracking over time. We characterize how performance degrades with world-state complexity and temporal horizon, and diagnose four failure modes: spatial collapse, semantic shortcuts, insufficient update, and instance confusion. This taxonomy reveals that models lack mechanisms to bind objects, agents, and environments into a unified spatial world model, a fundamental gap that defines the path forward for spatial supersensing.
tldr: This paper introduces VSI-Super-Wild, a large-scale benchmark for spatial supersensing in diverse in-the-wild videos, and shows that current multimodal models fail at tracking agent-object-environment world states over time, exposing a key gap for world modeling.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了VSI-Super-Wild，一个用于野生长视频空间超级感知的大规模基准，并表明当前多模态模型在随时间跟踪智能体-对象-环境世界状态方面失效，揭示了世界建模的关键差距。
summary_zh: 人类能够高效解析从数小时到数年的连续感知流，并以此构建支撑空间推理与预测的内部世界模型。为模仿这一能力，空间超感知对多模态模型提出了挑战，要求其超越语言理解，迈向真正的世界建模。然而，现有基准依赖由随机短片段拼接而成的合成长视频，且多局限于家庭场景，导致真实世界的连续性与多样性未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出 **VSI-Super-Wild**——一个大规模基准数据集，用于评估模型在长时间跨度下、多样野外场景中的空间超感知能力。值得注意的是，受认知科学中关于人类如何组织经验的研究启发，我们系统性地探究了世界状态的完整三元组：智能体（观察者）、物体（场景元素）与环境（场所及全局布局）。VSI-Super-Wild 总计包含 **6,980** 个人工验证的问答对，源自 **442** 个覆盖8类场景的真实世界视频，其中包括时长超过4小时的长视频记录。在 VSI-Super-Wild 上的实验结果揭示了一个根本性脱节：尽管静态图像理解取得了进展，但模型在需要随时间进行连贯世界状态追踪的任务中始终失败。我们刻画了性能随世界状态复杂度与时间跨度增加而下降的规律，并诊断出四种失败模式：空间坍缩、语义捷径、更新不足与实例混淆。这一分类表明，模型缺乏将物体、智能体与环境绑定为统一空间世界模型的机制——这一根本性缺陷定义了空间超感知的未来发展方向。

title: UniPhysGen: Unified Physical Grounding for Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
summary: Physically grounded 3D assets are increasingly important for embodied AI and robotic simulation. However, most existing 3D assets lack unified physical semantics, including articulation semantics and intrinsic physical properties, required for realistic interaction. Current approaches either treat these semantics independently or rely on canonicalized object structures, limiting robustness across heterogeneous 3D assets. We present UniPhys, a scalable framework for automatically transforming raw 3D assets into simulation-ready assets with unified physical semantics. Based on UniPhys, we construct UniPhys-40K, a large-scale physically grounded dataset, together with UniPhys-Bench, a carefully verified benchmark for unified physical grounding evaluation. We further introduce UniPhysGen, a unified physical grounding model that jointly reasons over articulation semantics and intrinsic physical properties. UniPhysGen incorporates geometry-robust articulation grounding to mitigate geometric shortcut bias under heterogeneous part decompositions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across articulation grounding and intrinsic physical property estimation tasks, while the resulting assets can be directly deployed in robotic simulation environments for realistic physical interaction. Our code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/breezexian/UniPhysGen.
tldr: UniPhysGen proposes a unified framework to automatically infer articulation semantics and physical properties from raw 3D assets, producing simulation-ready assets for embodied AI and robotics, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on physical grounding benchmarks.
tldr_zh: UniPhysGen 提出一个统一框架，自动从原始 3D 资产推断关节语义和物理属性，生成可用于具身 AI 和机器人仿真的资产，并在物理接地基准上达到最优性能。
summary_zh: 具有物理真实感的三维资产对于具身智能和机器人仿真日益重要。然而，现有大多数三维资产缺乏实现真实交互所需的统一物理语义，包括关节语义和内在物理属性。当前方法要么独立处理这些语义，要么依赖规范化的物体结构，这限制了其在异构三维资产中的鲁棒性。我们提出UniPhys，一个可扩展的框架，能够自动将原始三维资产转化为具有统一物理语义的仿真就绪资产。基于UniPhys，我们构建了UniPhys-40K大型物理真实感数据集，以及经过严格验证的统一物理地基评估基准UniPhys-Bench。我们进一步提出统一物理地基模型UniPhysGen，该模型联合推理关节语义和内在物理属性。UniPhysGen引入几何鲁棒的关节地基方法，以减轻异构部件分解下的几何捷径偏差。大量实验表明，该方法在关节地基和内在物理属性估计任务上达到了最先进性能，所生成的资产可直接部署于机器人仿真环境，实现真实的物理交互。我们的代码和数据集将在https://github.com/breezexian/UniPhysGen 公开。

title: GPOcc++: Unified Sparse Gaussian Occupancy Prediction with Visual Geometry Priors
summary: Accurate 3D scene understanding is fundamental to embodied intelligence and autonomous driving, where 3D occupancy provides a unified representation of objects, structures, and free space. However, recovering such a complete volumetric representation from visual observations remains challenging, particularly in occluded and unobserved regions. Visual geometry priors offer strong and generalizable geometric cues for addressing this challenge, but their outputs are inherently surface-centric, whereas occupancy prediction requires reasoning about volumetric interiors and free space. To bridge this gap, we introduce GPOcc, which transforms visual geometry priors into occupancy-aware sparse Gaussian representations for efficient and expressive volumetric scene modeling. Building on GPOcc, GPOcc++ models multi-view observations and temporal sequences within a unified framework, allowing spatial and temporal evidence to be handled through the same representation. We further extend GPOcc++ from indoor scenes to outdoor occupancy prediction. Extensive experiments on both indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong performance across both multi-view and temporal settings, together with favorable efficiency and generalization. Code will be released at https://github.com/JuIvyy/GPOcc.
tldr: GPOcc++ transforms visual geometry priors into occupancy-aware sparse Gaussian representations for efficient 3D scene occupancy prediction, unifying multi-view and temporal inputs for indoor and outdoor scenes.
tldr_zh: GPOcc++将视觉几何先验转化为占用感知的稀疏高斯表示，实现高效的三维场景占用预测，并统一了多视角和时间序列输入，适用于室内外场景。
summary_zh: 准确的三维场景理解是具身智能和自动驾驶的基础，其中三维占用为物体、结构和自由空间提供了统一的表达。然而，从视觉观测中恢复出完整的体素表示仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在遮挡和未被观测的区域。视觉几何先验为应对这一挑战提供了强健且可泛化的几何线索，但其输出本质上以表面为中心，而占用预测需要对体积内部和自由空间进行推理。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了GPOcc，它将视觉几何先验转化为对占用感知的高斯稀疏表示，以实现高效且富有表现力的体积场景建模。基于GPOcc，GPOcc++将多视角观测和时间序列建模于统一框架中，使得空间和时间证据能够通过相同的表示进行处理。我们进一步将GPOcc++从室内场景扩展到室外占用预测。在室内和室外基准上的广泛实验表明，该方法在多视角和时间设置下均具有持续强劲的性能，同时兼具良好的效率和泛化能力。代码将在 https://github.com/JuIvyy/GPOcc 开源。

title: Factorized Spectral Representations for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning a compact model of the world from interaction data is central to sample-efficient deep reinforcement learning. Spectral representation methods have become the leading paradigm for representation learning in continuous control by taking a matrix view of the transition kernel, with state-action pairs on one side and next states on the other, and learning a low-rank factorization through self-supervised contrastive objectives. We take this view one step further. The transition kernel is naturally a three-mode tensor over states, actions, and next states, and a CP decomposition gives one feature map per mode. We propose FaStR, which fits this decomposition with a noise contrastive objective, producing separate state, action, and next-state encoders that together form a single spectral representation. The factored form yields a smaller hypothesis class, and the sample size needed for representation learning shrinks by a factor that scales with the smaller of the state and action dimensions. Empirically, FaStR delivers its largest gains on high-dimensional locomotion tasks whose dynamics align with the factored structure, and the learned state encoder transfers intact across actuator shift while only the action encoder is retrained.
tldr: FaStR factorizes the transition kernel into separate state, action, and next-state encoders via CP decomposition and contrastive learning, improving sample efficiency in continuous control RL.
tldr_zh: FaStR 通过 CP 分解和对比学习将转移核分解为独立的状态、动作和下一状态编码器，提高了连续控制强化学习中的样本效率。
summary_zh: 学习一种从交互数据中构建环境紧致模型的方法，是高效利用样本的深度强化学习的核心。谱表示方法通过将转移核视为矩阵（一侧为状态-动作对，另一侧为下一状态），并利用自监督对比目标学习其低秩分解，已成为连续控制中表示学习的主流范式。我们进一步推进了这一观点。转移核本质上是关于状态、动作和下一状态的三模张量，对其施加CP分解可得到每个模式对应的特征映射。我们提出FaStR方法，通过噪声对比目标拟合该分解，生成独立的状态、动作和下一状态编码器，三者共同构成统一的谱表示。分解形式的假设空间更小，表示学习所需的样本量可减少一个因子，该因子与状态维度和动作维度中较小者成比例。实验表明，FaStR在动力学结构与分解形式一致的高维运动控制任务上提升最为显著；此外，当执行器发生偏移时，仅需重新训练动作编码器，而学习到的状态编码器可直接完整迁移。

title: Topology-Agnostic Mesh Reconstruction of Deformable Objects from Sparse Touch
summary: Estimating the full shape of a deformable object is especially challenging when vision is unavailable: in the dark, inside an opaque bag, behind the manipulating hand, or under heavy self-occlusion. Touch is the natural sensor in these settings, but touches are sparse and local. We present a single topology-agnostic estimator that reconstructs the full mesh of a deformable object from only a few touches and no vision, using one permutation-invariant cross-attention architecture that handles a 1D rope, a 2D cloth, and a 3D volumetric soft body. The learned estimator reduces reconstruction error by roughly two-thirds relative to non-learned geometric mesh completion and a Gaussian-process surface baseline, and it outperforms a simpler global-pool set encoder, with the gap growing as more touches are observed. We then show that the estimator's deep-ensemble uncertainty can be used to learn where to touch next, which lowers error further and beats both random touching and a Gaussian-process active baseline at sparse budgets. This gain is modest on average but grows with self-occlusion and on the error tail. When vision is also available, where to touch barely matters, motivating the vision-free setting we study.
tldr: A topology-agnostic model reconstructs full 3D meshes of deformable objects (rope, cloth, soft body) using only sparse touch data, with an active-touching strategy that reduces error further.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种拓扑无关的模型，仅利用稀疏触觉数据即可完全重建可变形物体（绳索、布料、软体）的3D网格，并采用主动触摸策略进一步降低误差。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在无法获取视觉信息的情况下——例如黑暗环境中、不透明袋内、被操作手遮挡时或存在严重自遮挡时——估计可变形物体的完整形状极具挑战性。触觉是此类场景中的天然传感器，但触觉数据稀疏且局部化。我们提出了一种单一拓扑无关的估计器，仅通过少量触觉信息且无需视觉输入，即可重建可变形物体的完整网格。该估计器采用一种置换不变性的交叉注意力架构，能够处理一维绳索、二维布料及三维体积软体。与基于非学习方法的几何网格补全及高斯过程表面基线相比，该学习型估计器的重建误差降低了约三分之二；同时，它优于简单的全局池化集合编码器，且随着触觉观测数量的增加，性能差距进一步扩大。我们进一步证明，该估计器的深度集成不确定性可用于学习下一次触觉探查的位置，从而在稀疏预算下进一步降低误差，效果优于随机触探及高斯过程主动基线。这种改进在平均情况下幅度有限，但在自遮挡严重时及误差尾部分布中显著提升。当视觉信息也可用时，触觉位置的选择影响甚微，这更凸显了我们研究的无视觉场景的必要性。

title: Deformable State Estimation for Autonomous Surgical Tissue Retraction Under Partial Observability
summary: Surgical tissue retraction requires effective manipulation planning under partial and noisy perception. We study state estimation for deformable tissue retraction, where only sparse observations of the tissue surface are available at decision time. We propose a learned state estimator that reconstructs the full deformable mesh state from 40 noisy vertex observations. The estimator combines a multilayer perceptron with a low-dimensional PCA latent representation and is trained using geometry-aware regularization that encourages smooth and physically plausible deformations. We evaluate the approach in a 2D deformable sheet simulation using single-step and multi-step retraction planning. Results show that the learned estimator achieves 98.1% of oracle performance in multi-step retraction while supporting efficient inference. These results demonstrate that learned, geometry-regularized state estimation can support effective deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.
tldr: Proposes a learned state estimator with geometry-aware regularization that reconstructs full deformable mesh states from sparse observations, achieving near-oracle performance in simulated surgical tissue retraction planning.
tldr_zh: 提出一种带几何感知正则化的学习状态估计器，能从稀疏观测中重建完整可变形网格状态，在模拟手术组织回缩规划中达到接近理想性能。
summary_zh: 外科组织牵开需要在部分观测和噪声感知条件下进行有效的操作规划。我们研究了可变形组织牵开中的状态估计问题，即在决策时刻仅能获取组织表面的稀疏观测数据。我们提出一种学习型状态估计器，能够从40个含噪声的顶点观测中重建完整可变形网格状态。该估计器将多层感知机与低维主成分分析潜在表示相结合，并通过几何感知正则化进行训练，以鼓励平滑且物理合理的变形。我们基于二维可变形薄片仿真，采用单步与多步牵开规划评估该方法。结果表明，在多步牵开任务中，该学习型估计器达到了参考系统的98.1%性能，同时支持高效推理。这些结果证明，基于几何正则化的学习型状态估计能够有效支持现实感知约束下的可变形操作。

title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
summary: Building interactive worlds that respond coherently to player actions has long been a shared goal of computer graphics, games, and artificial intelligence. Recent video generative models provide a data-driven route toward this goal by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions, and are increasingly regarded as potential next-generation game engines. Realizing a genuinely interactive game world, however, requires interaction outcomes that follow rules over evolving game conditions, consequences that persist over long horizons, and a generation loop that operates in real time. Conventional game engines realize these properties through a recurrent action-state-observation loop, in which player actions update an explicit game state according to predefined rules and observations are rendered from the resulting state. Taking this loop as an organizing lens, this paper examines interactive game world modeling along four dimensions: player action control, game state dynamics, state-observation persistence, and real-time interactive generation. For each dimension, we start from the capabilities required by an interactive game world, group existing approaches into representative families, and discuss the strengths and trade-offs of each family. Complementing this analysis, we present a scalable data engine for Black Myth: Wukong that collects over 90 hours of gameplay with frame-aligned player actions, ground-truth game states, and visual observations, together with structured and semantic annotations, as a resource for state-aware game world modeling. We hope this paper offers a clear picture of where the field stands and fosters progress toward interactive game worlds.
tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive survey of interactive world modeling for game engines, focusing on action control, state dynamics, persistence, and real-time generation, and introduces a large-scale gameplay dataset for Black Myth: Wukong with aligned actions, states, and observations.
tldr_zh: 本文从行动控制、状态动态、持久性和实时生成四个维度系统综述了交互式世界建模在游戏引擎中的应用，并发布了《黑神话：悟空》的大规模游戏数据集。

title: WAVE-Stereo: Warp-Aligned Volume Encoding for Stereo Matching
summary: Existing iterative stereo matching methods primarily adopt two types of correspondence representation: explicit matching search via correlation volumes and local residual refinement via warped features, yet the two remain separately modeled. We propose WAVE-Stereo, built on a core insight: correlation volumes and feature warping provide complementary matching cues. \textbf{GeoWarp Correspondence Encoder (GWCE)} encodes matching search, residual alignment, and disparity prior in parallel at the ConvGRU input. To mitigate matching degradation in textureless regions, we propose \textbf{Periodic Global Context Propagation (PGCP)}, which propagates global spatial information in a periodic manner. On five real-world benchmarks -- Middlebury, ETH3D, KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, and Booster -- WAVE-Stereo achieves competitive zero-shot generalization accuracy without any external foundation model prior, achieving 3.18\% D1-all on KITTI 2015, 4.42\% Bad-2.0 on Booster, and 66ms real-time inference, striking a favorable balance between accuracy and efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/yamanoko-do/WAVE-Stereo.
tldr: WAVE-Stereo improves stereo matching by fusing correlation volumes and feature warping in a parallel encoder, achieving strong zero-shot generalization on real-world benchmarks with real-time inference.
tldr_zh: WAVE-Stereo 通过并行编码相关体积与特征扭曲来改进立体匹配，在多个真实基准上实现了良好的零样本泛化能力和实时推理。

title: A VAE-Driven Multi-Task Satellite-Aided Semantic Communication Framework for 6G-Enabled Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary: The development of smart transportation systems and the introduction of 6G wireless communication technologies have significantly changed vehicle network topologies. Future connected autonomous vehicle (CAV) networks require bandwidth-efficient, reliable, and low-latency communication for safety-critical applications such as traffic sign recognition and decision-making. Conventional communication systems transmit raw data regardless of task relevance, which is inefficient in resource-constrained satellite channels where uplink bandwidth is scarce and propagation losses are large. Semantic communication addresses this limitation by transmitting task-relevant information instead of full signal representations. It extracts and conveys essential semantic features and leverages deep learning to optimize task performance at the receiver. Therefore, we present a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based multi-task semantic communication framework for satellite-assisted autonomous driving. Unlike deterministic autoencoder-based methods, the proposed model uses probabilistic latent representations for more robust and efficient encoding. The learned features are transmitted over noisy wireless channels to perform traffic sign reconstruction and classification. The framework is trained end-to-end to jointly optimize both tasks. Results show that the proposed approach achieves significant bandwidth reduction of up to 87.23\% to 98.17\% while maintaining stable performance across varying signal-to-noise ratio conditions.
tldr: This paper proposes a VAE-based multi-task semantic communication framework for satellite-assisted autonomous driving, achieving substantial bandwidth reduction by transmitting only task-relevant features for traffic sign reconstruction and classification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于VAE的多任务语义通信框架，用于卫星辅助的自主驾驶，通过仅传输与任务相关的特征来实现交通标志重建与分类，从而大幅降低带宽需求。

title: RENEW: Towards Learning World Models and Repairing Model Exploitation from Preferences
summary: World models are widely used in offline reinforcement learning (RL) to improve sample efficiency and generate experience beyond a fixed dataset. However, they are vulnerable to model exploitation where data coverage is thin. Prior work addresses this either by collecting more expert demonstrations, which is often expensive, unsafe, or unavailable, or by conservative algorithms that avoid uncertain regions, which limits generalization. We propose instead to repair exploitation directly using human preferences over imagined rollouts, leveraging the strong intuitive physics that allows humans to easily spot egregious dynamics hallucinations. We formalize this as Dynamics Learning from Human Feedback (DLHF), a Bradley-Terry preference loss over trajectory log-likelihoods under a learned dynamics model. Unfortunately, naive DLHF is sample inefficient, so we introduce RENEW, which uses epistemic uncertainty to focus finetuning where the model is most exploitable. We evaluate on several Jumanji and classic control environments and find that while naive DLHF requires an outsize preference budget, RENEW makes the framework practical by improving sample efficiency, limiting catastrophic forgetting, and reducing exploitation in pretrained world models. Taken together, our results provide initial evidence that preferences can supervise world model dynamics directly, offering a new approach to addressing exploitation in offline model-based RL.
tldr: RENEW addresses model exploitation in offline model-based RL by using human preferences over imagined rollouts to finetune world models, with an epistemic-uncertainty-based sampling strategy to improve sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: RENEW通过利用人类对想象轨迹的偏好来微调世界模型，并采用基于认知不确定性的采样策略提高样本效率，解决了离线模型强化学习中的模型利用问题。

title: Recursive ArUco Markers: A Scalable Fiducial Marker Design for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Landing Pads
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) increasingly rely on visual fiducial markers for autonomous navigation and precision landing. However, standard markers suffer from limited operational ranges, becoming undetectable when the camera is either too far or too close. While recursive and fractal markers have been proposed to address this issue, existing approaches either require the marker's center to remain visible, making them vulnerable to occlusion, or are limited in their recursion depth and placement. We propose a novel Recursive ArUco marker design. Our method allows any standard fiducial marker to be transformed into a recursive marker with an arbitrary depth. By employing a modified bit-sampling strategy during detection, we embed complete markers within both the black and white bits of the parent marker. This approach guarantees unlimited recursion depth and robust detection even with partial occlusion, as it does not rely on the marker's center being visible. Furthermore, by maintaining a single, unique identifier across all recursive scales, our proposal provides an extensive dictionary of multiple unique landing pads. This capability allows fleets of UAVs to operate simultaneously, with each drone landing at its designated location -- a feature not supported by existing Fractal and Harco markers due to their structural and dictionary constraints.
tldr: This paper introduces a recursive ArUco marker design that embeds complete markers within parent marker bits, enabling unlimited recursion depth and robust detection under occlusion, supporting simultaneous multi-UAV landing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种递归ArUco标记设计，将完整标记嵌入父标记位中，实现无限递归深度和部分遮挡下的鲁棒检测，支持多无人机同时降落。

title: From Surface Forecasting to Observability Forecasting: A Latent World Model for Cloud-Aware EO Monitoring
summary: The bottleneck of Earth Observation processing chains is not the arrival of new imagery but whether the surface is actually visible when the image arrives. We study this as an observability forecasting problem on EarthNet2021. Given recent multispectral imagery and exogenous weather drivers, the goal is to predict whether the next acquisition will be usable and, if not, when a usable view is likely to return. To do this, we adapt LeWorldModel, a joint-embedding predictive architecture world model, to cloud-aware Earth Observation sequences. The final pipeline converts raw minicubes into episodic HDF5 sequences with five image channels (blue, green, red, near-infrared, cloud mask) and eight meteorological and calendar covariates. The resulting model has 18.0M trainable parameters and is trained from scratch on 23,904 training episodes. The trained leWorldModel is evaluated under a locked protocol: linear probes are fit on train only, calibration choices are set on an internal validation split, and the fitted heads are then frozen for valsplit, IID, OOD, and extreme evaluation. On the full frozen-bundle observability benchmark, LeWorldModel consistently outperforms persistence. For next-step usability, balanced accuracy ranges from 0.769 to 0.887, compared with 0.493 to 0.556 for persistence. For exact first-usable-horizon prediction, accuracy ranges from 0.602 to 0.806, compared with 0.120 to 0.369 for persistence. Against a frozen LightGBM baseline fit on the same training windows, LeWorldModel is better on continuous clear/cloud regression and on exact recovery timing on valsplit, IID, and extreme, while LightGBM is stronger on the simpler binary any-usable-within-six task and is more robust on OOD. In separate sampled diagnostic analyses, LeWM also produces strong ranking-based anomaly signals under synthetic temporal inconsistencies.
tldr: This paper adapts a joint-embedding world model (LeWorldModel) to forecast cloud-driven observability for Earth Observation, predicting whether satellite imagery will be usable and when a clear view returns.
tldr_zh: 本文通过一种联合嵌入世界模型（LeWorldModel）来预测云层导致的地球观测可见性，判断卫星图像是否可用以及何时能恢复清晰视野。

title: Visual Place Recognition Using Rate-Encoded Spiking Neural Networks with Discrete STDP Learning
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) trained through unsupervised Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) have been explored as solutions to visual loop closure problems, driven by the prospect of efficient on-device inference on neuromorphic devices. State-of-the-art STDP-based models deliver high classification accuracy but fail to reach the high Recall at 100% Precision (R@100P) needed for reliable autonomous navigation. We present a discrete, tensor-native implementation of the STDP-based SNN-VPR pipeline using PyTorch with snnTorch and evaluate it on a 100-place Nordland dataset using 15 independently-trained networks. The contribution of three decisions in the implementation is investigated. First, we show how to perform neuron assignment with a closed-form, deterministic tensor pipeline and show that it provides significantly higher R@100P than a standard argmax procedure. However, some of this gain comes from implementation differences compared to prior continuous-time models, which we measure independently. Second, ablation in isolation shows that state reset after each query helps improve R@100P regardless of the way neurons are assigned. Third, velocity-compensated sliding window aggregation over k consecutive frames reaches R@100P = 100.00% at k = 5 for constant-velocity traversal and an additional 0.20 ms latency.
